newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's popular insult enters National Assembly.
newsitem.headline: France's popular insult enters National Assembly.

text.p: An obscenity rang out during question time in France's National Assembly on Wednesday, and shocked party leaders were unable to identify the culprit.

They said the shout of "nique ta mere" (fuck your mother) came from an unidentified centrist as leftist deputy Christiane Taubira-Delannon was questioning the government on recent riots in her French Guiana constituency.
Assembly Speaker Philippe Seguin called in party leaders to investigate the incident which he said was in very bad taste. He hoped the insult was not directed at the woman deputy.

The party leaders urged the culprit to step forward, or at least apologise to Taubira-Delannon. They said Seguin would write to each parliamentarian to remind them that dignity and mutual respect were required from the nation's representatives.

The insult, popular with suburban youths, has become fashionable in France since two singers of a rap group called NTM -- after the insult -- were jailed for three months for using lyrics savaging the police.
The tough punishment outraged free speech advocates and Justice Minister Jacques Toubon has appealed to try to have the sentence reduced.
